'''Greater Piq Island''' was an island on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] that was connected to [[Lesser Piq Island]] by the 30 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long [[Buichol Isthmus]].<ref name="CatCW" />
